witness.branch: Same-lane overtaking or passing on a multilane road
witness.quote: a person shall not drive a motorcycle, moped or trimobile abreast of or overtake or pass another vehicle within the same traffic lane.
witness.reason: A one-way multilane road can contain an overtaking episode within one lane; the existence of adjacent lanes does not require their use.
required_context: Construct a one-way road wide enough for at least two lines of vehicles.
Identify ego as a motorcycle under the supplied definition and identify its driver.
Identify the driver and establish motorcycle classification under the supplied Chapter 486 definition, including its exclusions; appearance alone is insufficient.
Identify the other participant as a qualifying vehicle under the supplied vehicle definition.

If a motorcycle or moped is used as the other vehicle instead, preserve the express permission for no more than two motorcycles or mopeds abreast with driver consent; physical arrangement does not establish consent.
Place a qualifying other vehicle ahead and construct a supported passing route within their shared lane.
Preserve NRS 486.351(3) as an unresolved exception whose operative text is absent.

Provide sufficient shared-lane width and a physically supported route from behind to ahead; retain lane geometry, adjacent-lane occupancy, both vehicles' lane occupancy, longitudinal relationship, lateral arrangement and surface gap throughout the episode.
Record adjacent lane geometry and actual occupancy throughout the episode.
Treat the behind-to-ahead span as evidence coverage, without inventing numerical legal boundaries for passing, abreast operation, lane occupancy or clearance.
witness.subject_reason: This available party includes the driver of the selected motorcycle, an express statutory subject.
